text: Alphabet animal relay: each team member says a different animal in alphabetical order.
instructions: Press Start. Go around the team. Each player says one animal; every answer must be different and later in the alphabet than the one before it.

text: Eight-move route: start at the top-left of the grid. Each player says Right or Down once. Reach the bottom-right in exactly 8 moves.
answer: Reach target with 4 Right and 4 Down.
instructions: Press Start. Begin at the top-left square. No discussion: each player says only Right or Down once. The team wins only if the path ends at the bottom-right after 8 moves.
